source: Lone, Prabhakaran, Rabczuk, Zhuang, Constitutive-fibre mechanics, arXiv:2611.22187, Sec. 9.3 (open-hole lamina); their result is for one mesh (4,096 quadratic triangles, 64 x 32 divisions)
adapter_description: Open-hole composite lamina (CFM paper, arXiv:2611.22187, Sec. 9.3): elliptical plate, semi-axes 50 mm and 10 mm, thickness 1 mm, central hole of radius 3 mm, unidirectional AS4/3501-6 with fibres at 15 degrees to the long axis, plane stress, linear orthotropic reference law (E1 126 GPa, E2 11 GPa, G12 6.6 GPa, nu12 0.28). Boundary tractions of a homogeneous uniaxial stress along the long axis; three displacement components at the hole fixed (rigid motions of the balanced load). Q2 (9-node) mapped mesh, 16m x 8m divisions around/radially (m = 4: the paper's 64 x 32), graded toward the hole g = 1.5; strategies g = 1.0, 2.0 at m = 8. Smooth boundary everywhere: no corners. QoIs: compliance = f.u/P^2; u_tip = u_x at (50,0); hole_gamma12_avg, hole_e22_avg = area means of the material-axis shear and transverse strain over the annulus 3 <= r <= 6 mm; far_gamma12_avg = mean shear strain over the disc of radius 3 mm at (25,0); hole_gk_gamma12_avg, hole_gk_e22_avg = the hole means with the weight exp(-((r-3)/1.5)^2); peak_e22 = max transverse strain over the Gauss points.
known_limitations_stated_in_advance: the QoI vocabulary does not know 'compliance' (class unknown): it is a global, energy-type quantity (f.u/P^2), which the rules cannot see
our zone definitions are not the paper's (the paper does not define them); the comparison with the CFM widths is for quantities of the same kind, not identical ones
linear reference law only (the paper's widths are at 0.6 P_D with the nonlinear fitted law); relative discretization errors of a linear problem are used as the estimate

developer_expectations.compliance, u_tip: PASS with rate; observed order 3-5 (smooth, Q2: energy-type order 2k = 4)
developer_expectations.peak_e22: PASS (converging, bounded; order about 1 from the Gauss-point offset), located at the hole edge
developer_expectations.CFM resolution (m = 4) against the CFM w: discretization uncertainty of compliance and of the hole/far-field shear strain at m = 4 below 1/3 of the CFM width (margin >= 3), i.e. the paper's mesh is adequate for its ranges
